posts.title: Getting Started with Run Tempo: Your Ultimate Running Music Companion
posts.content:
# Getting Started with Run Tempo

Welcome to Run Tempo! This guide will help you get started with our application and make the most of your running experience.

## What is Run Tempo?

Run Tempo is an innovative application that helps runners maintain their perfect pace by adjusting music to match their target running tempo. Whether you're training for a marathon or just enjoying a casual jog, having the right rhythm can make all the difference.

### Key Features

1. **Custom BPM Adjustment**
   - Upload your favorite songs
   - Set your target running pace
   - Let our AI adjust the tempo

2. **Smart Volume Control**
   - Fine-tune the metronome volume
   - Perfect blend with your music

## How to Use Run Tempo

1. **Upload Your Music**
   ```
   - Select your favorite running tracks
   - Supported formats: MP3, WAV
   - Upload up to 5 files at once
   ```

2. **Set Your Pace**
   > Finding your ideal running tempo is crucial. Most runners prefer a cadence between 160-180 BPM.

### Tips for Best Results

* Start with our sample tracks to get familiar with the system
* Experiment with different BPM settings
* Save your favorite settings for quick access

---

**Ready to get started?** Head over to our upload section and transform your first track!
